name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Gravity Assist Mobility Pack GAMP-2
product_name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Gravity Assist Mobility Pack GAMP-2
description: A backpack-mounted graviton emitter that reduces the wearer's effective weight by up to 80%, enabling enormous leaps, controlled descent from heights, and movement speeds that appear superhuman. The GAMP-2 does not provide true flight — it reduces gravity's effect on the wearer rather than generating lift — but a person weighing effectively 20% of their normal mass can jump 5-story buildings, run along walls for short distances, and survive falls that would kill an unassisted person. The pack's graviton emitter draws enormous power and provides only 15 minutes of active weight reduction per charge cycle.

specifications.fall survival: Terminal velocity reduced to non-lethal levels
specifications.cryogenic requirement: None — uses room-temperature graviton emitter variant

story_hooks: A suspect escaped pursuit by leaping from a 10-story building and surviving — witnesses describe them floating to the ground, and the graviton signature detected by building sensors confirms a GAMP-2 was used.
A GAMP-2 malfunctioned during a jump, switching from weight reduction to weight amplification — the user went from weighing 15 kg to 400 kg in mid-air.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, angular backpack with a pronounced central dorsal ridge housing the graviton emitter core. The design resembles a exoskeletal carapace rather than traditional luggage — aggressive, purpose-built, with downward-swept side panels and reinforced load-bearing struts. The pack sits high on the shoulders, distributing weight through a rigid titanium frame.
physical_description.dimensions: 48 cm tall × 35 cm wide × 18 cm deep; compact enough for urban movement but visually imposing
physical_description.weight_description: 5.5 kg — handheld carrying weight, but intended to be worn; shoulder straps are padded and adjustable; the pack rides high and tight against the back
physical_description.primary_material: Carbon-composite polymer shell with titanium load frame; internal cavity lined with industrial-grade thermal dispersion material
physical_description.finish: Matte gunmetal with brushed titanium accents; textured grip panels on shoulder straps; slight iridescent sheen on the graviton emitter housing from metamaterial coating
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal gray primary with neon cyan accent striping along seams and control interfaces; Zheng-Dao brand red (deep crimson) on corner reinforcements
physical_description.interface_elements: Central thumb-dial control (rotating input wheel) on right shoulder strap; LED status bar running down dorsal ridge (blue = idle, cyan = active, red = low battery); micro-haptic feedback pads; small holographic display panel (2.5 inch) above right shoulder showing charge percentage and weight reduction percentage; emergency manual kill-switch recessed on left side
distinctive_features: Visible graviton emitter core visible through reinforced translucent panel on dorsal ridge — appears as a faintly luminous crystalline structure with subtle wavering distortion field
Thermal venting grilles on lower back panel with active blue LED cooling indicator
Attachment rails on all four sides for modular load carriers
Haptic feedback grid embedded in straps for touch-based control feedback
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Large Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries ideogram (燕道) embossed on left shoulder panel in metallic cyan; serial number and regulatory certification stamps on interior access panel; small printed warning labels in English, Mandarin, Spanish, and Swahili
physical_description.condition_typical: Scuffed from field use, minor scratches on composite shell; cooling vents often show dust accumulation; holographic display sometimes partially obscured by sweat or condensation during active use; users frequently tape emergency release instructions on the back
